title: Optimizers for Diffusion Models: A Controlled Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2609.23055v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Discrete diffusion models now match autoregressive language models on several benchmarks, while the question of how best to train them has received far less attention: the optimizer is inherited from one paper to the next and never compared. New optimizers, meanwhile, are validated almost exclusively on autoregressive pretraining, a different objective on a different loss surface. We present a controlled optimizer benchmark across four diffusion formulations, to our knowledge the first for discrete diffusion: seven optimizers (AdamW, Lion, Muon, SOAP, MARS, MARS-M, Schedule-Free) on masked diffusion (text8), uniform diffusion (QM9, and LM1B through the Gaussian duality) and Gaussian diffusion on images (CelebA-64), each on a task with published reference values. Every optimizer receives the same search protocol, and every winner is retrained at the full budget with three seeds. AdamW is a strong default but not always the right choice: i

translated_title: 扩散模型的优化器：一项受控基准测试
translated_abstract: 离散扩散模型如今在多个基准测试上已能与自回归语言模型相媲美，但如何最优地训练它们这一问题却鲜受关注：优化器从一篇论文沿用到下一篇论文，从未被比较过。与此同时，新优化器几乎只在自回归预训练上进行验证，而那是不同损失曲面上的不同目标。我们提出了一项涵盖四种扩散形式的受控优化器基准测试，据我们所知这是首个针对离散扩散的基准：在掩码扩散（text8）、均匀扩散（QM9，以及通过高斯对偶性的LM1B）和图像上的高斯扩散（CelebA-64）上测试了七种优化器（AdamW、Lion、Muon、SOAP、MARS、MARS-M、Schedule-Free），每项任务都有已发表的参考值。每个优化器都采用相同的搜索协议，每个获胜者都以完整预算、使用三个随机种子重新训练。AdamW是一个强大的默认选择，但并不总是正确的选择：……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个针对离散扩散模型的受控优化器基准测试，在四种扩散形式上以统一协议系统比较了七种优化器，发现AdamW是强大的默认选择但并非在所有场景下都最优。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first controlled optimizer benchmark for discrete diffusion models, systematically comparing seven optimizers across four diffusion formulations under a unified protocol, and finding that AdamW is a strong default but not always the optimal choice.
